annotations.title: Trace a transfer through a mixer, exchange or swap service

description: Follow one transfer through the mixer (Privacy Cash, Cloak, Umbra, encrypt.trade, MagicBlock Private Payments, ShadowWire, Solana Privacy Rings...), exchange, or instant-swap service (SideShift, ChangeNOW, FixedFloat, SimpleSwap, StealthEX, Changelly...) on its other side, by timing and amount: for a deposit, the withdrawals that match it after; for a withdrawal, the deposits that match it before. Gives the likely wallets with a confidence, and how many transfers of the same amount could also fit (the anonymity set). A swap service pays out in another asset, often on another chain: a deposit into SideShift is matched exactly from SideShift's public record of completed shifts (the coin, network and amount it paid out, and the Solana recipient), any other by value at the prices of the time (1 of N candidates). One-time deposit addresses that sweep to the service count as the service. Give the wallet and the signature (transaction hash) of a transaction where it sent money to, or received money from, a mixer, an exchange or a swap service (analyze_address and get_connections list them). Off Solana: on Tron through an exchange or an instant exchange, on an EVM chain through an instant exchange or a privacy pool (Tornado Cash, Railgun, Privacy Pools), on Bitcoin through a CoinJoin or an instant exchange. Solana Privacy Rings (Helius) is followed by owner, not amount: its default ring hides amounts but publishes owners, so a deposit leads to the withdrawals and private transfers its owner signed, and a withdrawal to the owner that signed it and what paid that owner (exact links). With hops 2, a deposit is traced as a private swap through two exchanges, the way Houdini Swap routes through two of its 12 partner exchanges (a middle coin between them that isn't followed): on any chain, also when the wallet paid an address Iris doesn't know (a partner's one-time deposit address often names nothing on chain; the largest wallet paid, or the counterparty given, is taken as it), paired with the partners' payouts within 90 minutes by value. It is called a Houdini Swap route only when a Houdini partner's wallets are on both legs; otherwise "Private swap, Houdini-style (2 exchanges)". A lead, not proof: the middle leg isn't seen, and it says how many partners were searched. A deposit into an exchange's deposit address (Binance, KuCoin, Bybit, OKX...: labeled, or seen sweeping into the exchange) is traced every way it can come straight back out at once, on every chain: the same exchange's payouts within minutes ("Instant swap through a Binance account": a broker on an account there, or the owner withdrawing at once), a Houdini-style route's partner payouts, and, for Husher's known deposit addresses, "Swap through Husher". One verdict line says which fits best, or "No matching withdrawal ...: most likely a plain deposit", which is common: most deposits are just deposits, and a payout without an on-chain tie to the sender scores a few percent at most. A payout is named by the wallets' owner ("through ChangeNOW's wallets"), never by a brand that may route through them. The chain is read from the wallet's address (pass chain for an EVM chain other than Ethereum). Costs 1 trace (or 3 pack credits), or without an API key $0.25 paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. Results are leads, not proof.

chain.description: The transfer's chain, when the wallet's address doesn't say it: an EVM chain for a 0x wallet (ethereum by default).

counterparty.description: Optional: the exchange, swap service or mixer wallet (or pool contract) on the other side, when the transaction moved money with several. Iris picks the one it knows otherwise.

direction.description: Optional, with counterparty: out when the wallet paid it (a deposit), in when it paid the wallet (a withdrawal).

hops.description: Optional: 2 traces the transfer as a private swap through two exchanges, Houdini-style (Houdini Swap's partner exchanges), even to an address Iris doesn't know (taken as a partner's one-time deposit address); named a Houdini Swap route only with partner wallets on both legs. A lead, not proof. 1 (the default): one exchange.

signature.description: The transaction: a Solana signature (base58), an EVM or Tron transaction hash, or a Bitcoin txid.

wallet.description: The wallet whose deposit or withdrawal is traced (not the exchange or the mixer).
